description: This Java source file defines the EntityPermissionChecker class which provides methods for managing and checking permissions related to content entities within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes logic for permission evaluation based on roles, purposes, statuses, and other conditions, along with nested classes and interfaces for handling permission conditions, auxiliary values, roles, and related utilities.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker
classes.description: Main class providing permission checking services for entities, including inner interfaces and classes for condition getting, auxiliary value management, role handling, and permission evaluation logic.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker.PermissionConditionGetter
classes.description: Interface for iterating over permission conditions with methods to access role, operation, status, privilege, and auxiliary values, along with initialization and utility methods.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker.StdPermissionConditionGetter
classes.description: Implementation of PermissionConditionGetter, handling standard permission condition retrieval from entity list with various setup options.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker.AuxiliaryValueGetter
classes.description: Interface for managing auxiliary values related to permission conditions.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker.StdAuxiliaryValueGetter
classes.description: Implementation of AuxiliaryValueGetter for extracting auxiliary values from ContentPurpose entities.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker.RelatedRoleGetter
classes.description: Interface for retrieving related role information, including methods for initialization with or without ancestor traversal.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker.StdRelatedRoleGetter
classes.description: Implementation of RelatedRoleGetter, responsible for fetching roles associated with Content entities, including owner role identification.

methods.name: EntityPermissionChecker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the permission checker based on XML element configuration.

methods.name: runPermissionCheck
methods.description: Executes a permission check based on provided context map and returns whether access is granted.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Static method to verify permission on content, returning a map with permission status, based on various input parameters including user login, content content, statuses, and security helper.

methods.name: checkPermissionMethod
methods.description: Core static method implementing the permission logic, evaluating entity IDs, roles, purposes, statuses, and other conditions, returning overall permission result.

methods.name: getNextEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the next entity from either a string ID, GenericValue, or cache, using delegator and entity name.

methods.name: checkHasRoleOperations
methods.description: Checks if a user has specified role operations, based on partyId, permission conditions, and delegator.

methods.name: hasMatch
methods.description: Determines if an entity or set of conditions matches permission criteria based on roles, purposes, statuses, and operation list.

methods.name: getRelatedPurposes
methods.description: Fetches related purposes for an entity, adding them to passed purposes list.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Determines user roles associated with an entity, considering ownership, related roles, and group membership.

methods.name: isGroupMember
methods.description: Checks if a partyId belongs to a specified group relationship.

methods.name: getUserRolesFromList
methods.description: Queries and retrieves distinct roles for a list of entity IDs linked to a party.

methods.name: getEntityOwners
methods.description: Recursively finds owner entities for a given entity and adds their IDs to a list.

methods.name: getPrivilegeEnumSeq
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence number for a privilege enumeration ID.
